text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE landscape 3:2 full-body turnaround sheet: exactly THREE equal-size head-to-toe figures of the SAME character and costume, left strict FRONT, center strict 90-degree SIDE facing right, right strict BACK. All at same scale, height and foot baseline, all hair and footwear visible, arms naturally down. No extra portraits or panels. Character-specific body: 193 cm, broad armored warrior with powerful long limbs. Approximately 8.0 to 8.2 anatomical heads tall from skull crown (exclude tall hair, crown, ears and hat) to soles. Long elegant legs and arms, natural normal neck, proportionate head; do not fake height with heels, tiny shrunken head, stretched neck or camera distortion. Different characters retain distinctive builds. Full outfit: Silver and midnight-blue armor extended coherently: etched breastplate, articulated vambraces, sapphire split tabard, metal thigh guards and greaves over dark fitted underlayer, matching armored boots.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Male age 29, fantasy knight-cultivator. Long deep chestnut hair half tied behind crown, a loose wavy side lock, steel-blue eyes. Broad diamond face, strong rounded chin, slightly hooded eyes, dense horizontal eyebrows, short aquiline nose, firm wide lips. Light warm ivory skin. Original silver and midnight-blue armor with elegant curved layered shoulders, sapphire textile panels, fine etched cloud geometry instead of copied emblems. Upright relaxed arms DOWN. Steady protective gaze.
reproduction_note: 此为带身份参考图生成的补充素材；独立文字提示词已重建，未经纯文生图复现验证。严格同脸请同时使用身份母版。
